description: "Summon three patches of skeletal claws from the ground in front of you. Enemies in the first area are snared by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, immobilized in the second area for |cffffff4|r seconds, and stunned in the final area for |cffffff3|r seconds.\n\nEach area applies Major Maim to enemies and Empower to your allies for |cffffff10|r seconds, reducing enemy damage done by |cffffff10|r% and allied Heavy Attack Damage against monsters by |cffffff70|r%."
